Elena Park: Hi team — first day! Quick Q: where do I find the canonical team docs and page templates for product + oncall? I can view the workspace but not sure where to start :wave:
Devex Bot: Welcome Elena! Please see the Devex hub: https://redwood.notion.so/devex-home — it contains links to Team Templates, Oncall Playbooks, and Getting Started checklists. If you need edit access, run `/doc-access request` in Slack or fill this form: https://forms.redwood.ai/doc-access
Elena Park: Thanks! I clicked the hub but some pages say "View only". Should I duplicate templates or request edit rights?
Priya Rao: Hi Elena — welcome! For product + oncall templates you should duplicate first: open the template page > ••• > Duplicate — then move it into your personal space or the team space (Product > Product Playbooks). For anything you want to maintain in the shared Product space, request edit access so we can add you to the Product Editors group.
Sam: If you need a faster route, tag me or @Priya and include the Notion page URL + your email. Priya, can you grant Elena edit if it looks ok?
Priya Rao: Yep I can. Elena, paste the Notion page link you want edit on and I’ll add you. Also FYI we use these templates: "RFC", "Postmortem", "Runbook", and a lightweight "Weekly Update" — they live in Devex > Team Templates.
Elena Park: Link: https://redwood.notion.so/Product-Playbooks/abc123 — thanks! Also curious: any conventions for front-matter / metadata on pages? e.g., owner, lifecycle, retention?
Marcus: Quick note — for retention we tag pages with a "retention" property and set review cadence. Front-matter in templates has properties: Owner, Status, Review Date, Tags. Please don't remove the properties when duplicating.
Priya Rao: Done — Elena, you should have edit now. One last tip: when you duplicate a template, run the setup checklist at the top of the duplicated page (link to checklist inside template). If anything looks off ping #devex and we’ll help. :thumbsup:
Elena Park: Got it, I have edit access and duplicated the RFC template. Appreciate the help!
Sam: Welcome aboard again :tada: — feel free to DM for any onboarding docs you can't find.
